policy: Pointers only: no upstream source text is stored in this repository. Files are fetched only by 'tantular-cyber realworld fetch' into a local cache (default ~/.cache/tantular-cyber/realworld), verified by git blob SHA-1 at the pinned commit, and never executed or uploaded. Upstream licenses are recorded for transparency; copyleft or unknown-license sources are pointer-only. Upstream labels are hypotheses until independently verified.
